question.text: Which of the following is a general investment restriction that applies to mutual fund schemes under SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations?

answer.text: A mutual fund scheme may invest in equity shares of companies
A mutual fund scheme may invest in money market instruments
A mutual fund scheme may invest in debt securities
A mutual fund shall not advance any loans

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations state that the Mutual Fund shall not advance any loans. This is a general investment restriction designed to protect investors' money and preserve the fiduciary nature of the scheme. Mutual fund schemes are permitted to invest in equity, debt, and money market instruments subject to the scheme's investment objective. The Trap: Options A, B, and C describe permitted investment activities for a mutual fund scheme. The restriction is specifically on the advancement of loans by the mutual fund. Note: NISM Series V-A workbook (page 82) lists "the Mutual Fund shall not advance any loans" among the general investment restrictions applicable to mutual fund schemes.
